info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Delete Account Management By Param1-spec
info.description: The Account Management Deletion API allows for the removal of specific account management entries based on a unique identifier, referred to as Param1. This endpoint is particularly useful for financial institutions looking to manage user accounts effectively by eliminating outdated or unwanted entries. Typical consumers include developers integrating account management functionalities into their banking applications. The API ensures that account data is maintained accurately and responsibly.

delete.description: This operation deletes the specified position management entry identified by RES-100045. Ensure that you have the necessary permissions to perform this action.

requestBody.description: Request body for deleting a specific position identified by RES-100045. This operation requires the relevant details to correctly process the deletion request.

DeleteAccountManagementByParam1Request.description: This schema represents the request body for deleting a specific position in the account management system. The body should be a string indicating the position to be deleted.
